It’s exactly as outrageous as it sounds. Congress must investigate. Congress must demand answers. Congress must use every tool available to stop taxpayer dollars from being turned into a slush fund for Trump’s allies. But congressional Republicans won’t do that — because they’ve made it clear they’re more interested in protecting Trump’s power than holding him accountable. = | = EMILYs List has endorsed 25 Democratic pro-choice women running to flip Republican-held seats, plus 14 women running to hold critical blue seats in tough districts. * * *
Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin.
---
And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. Violent agitators hurled rocks, frozen water bottles, and exploding fireworks directly at police officers. Buildings were vandalized and looted. Police vehicles were set on fire. A rioter was caught with a Molotov cocktail. Officers were injured. The city was teetering on the edge of complete chaos, and everyone knew it.
On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held.
**No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him.**
And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza.
Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops.
Chance became one of his targets.
| Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training.
---
My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is **now scheduled for June of this year.** Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June.

clean_body: | Officer Chance Bretches and his family — Austin, Texas Dear Friend, My name is Kimberly Bretches. I'm a wife and a mother of four young children. And I'm writing to you today because I am out of options and I am terrified. I'll be honest, asking strangers for help doesn't come naturally to me. But neither does the idea of my husband spending the rest of his life in prison for doing his job — so here I am. Chance is a police officer in Austin, Texas. He is, without question, the best man I know. He has spent his career keeping dangerous people off the streets, protecting a city that doesn't always make it easy to do so, and coming home every night to a family that needs him. His supervisors have praised him for his professionalism, for his instincts, for his dedication. He is exactly the kind of officer you want showing up when things go wrong. | By every measure, Chance did everything right. He used department-approved tools, following his training, to protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. And in May of 2020, things went very wrong in Austin. For three consecutive days, our city was under siege. Violent agitators hurled rocks, frozen water bottles, and exploding fireworks directly at police officers. Buildings were vandalized and looted. Police vehicles were set on fire. A rioter was caught with a Molotov cocktail. Officers were injured. The city was teetering on the edge of complete chaos, and everyone knew it. On May 31st, the third day, when the mob was larger and more dangerous than it had ever been, Chance was on the front lines. He did what he was trained to do. He deployed non-lethal, department-approved beanbag projectiles to stop the aggression and protect his fellow officers and the people of Austin. The crowd eventually dispersed. The city held. No one questioned what he did that night. His supervisors praised his response. His department stood behind him. And then Austin elected District Attorney José Garza. Instead of holding the rioters accountable — the ones who threw the fireworks, who lit the fires, who carried the Molotov cocktails — Garza turned his attention to the officers who stopped them. He launched an indiscriminate campaign against law enforcement, using the power of his office not to protect the public, but to make political examples out of good cops. Chance became one of his targets. | Chance now faces up to 99 Years in prison — for following his training. My husband now faces up to 99 years in prison. Not because he did anything wrong. Not because his department found fault with his actions. Not because any credible review of that night concluded he acted improperly. But because one politically-motivated prosecutor decided the officers who held the line deserved to be punished for holding it. This case has been grinding through the system for years now. The trial has already been delayed several times and is now scheduled for June of this year. Every continuance, every filing, every hearing means more hours of legal work, and more bills our family has to find a way to pay. I am asking for your help because we cannot do this alone. The National Center for Police Defense has been in Chance's corner, and your donation goes toward funding his legal defense, ensuring he has the representation he deserves as he walks into that courtroom in June. | · · · or any amount you can give If you believe that the men and women who run toward danger deserve better than this, . Whatever you can. No amount is too small, and our family will not forget it. Chance stood between Austin and chaos on May 31st, 2020. He didn't hesitate. He didn't run. He did his job. Now I'm asking you to stand with him. With gratitude and hope, Kimberly Bretches Wife of Officer Chance Bretches, Austin Police Department | P.S. Chance's trial is this June. We are closer than we've ever been to getting Chance in front of a jury that will hear the truth, but we need the resources to get there. ** National Center for Police Defense · Defenders for Justice

body:
House votes to end Trump's Iran campaign — his first major Congressional defeat.

|
---
|
---
Sponsored By:
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O4yAUhZ8Gd7EuF2PsgmK1kbustlhpS4S5kKDgHwEZT95-lGieYMpzPukc6ft_MRcbU1yvf-zida7B0EaGVmcfddvL0y-zzdmWsvi1-mIQsD-BPCE3azK8IU2OLHeN11ypsYNhBGhuWtCswI5kSarAhQJBTqJ0QF76Tokm6tcUSEQA3knVhmFA0aPogqRx5j3rwCafa5v9_phTdHatttzDlp1v3bY0Sd9q3QsTvxhODKfjONpn_qz5_sIMJxuCcUxMWwg-m0hMnBF7UAz7F3oXfOyG71weMxPnf39_N1nTfsSUYukV6-C62Jjel_UHhj40fgUAAP__PN5zDg)
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Republican Task Force Issue: 5/21/2026
House War Powers Vote

The House is voting today on a [War Powers Resolution](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D1uxCAUBODT4A7r8WywXVCkcbdpU1qYn10UDAjYoNw-2j1CuilG80nzdTtuygcf75_qsrI0d5hkDhO1eraU66-9TlWKqvWysdl6IKCgwCmyI4aDDUYabRTTg5VsWbYZ1g1geMhFG1gZE3aahePLJrhY4OROsNNpPeHg5WsKOCIAm_kyunXFSeA0O262kwkygwq2tLHY_DyD1yo2Vb9dKtqOOl1DkI_WciXTB8Gd4N57H3MKvnmdXgWCe7S9EtxfEsEd-DsT3HWK92Jrpb6oSFt5Xpl2VWhO3ZZKu48UYMNtXWEo0uTuQ_BVLGSG-6V8ePvtH3f9SPwLAAD__81rd4k) to force President Trump to end the military campaign against Iran -- the same measure the Senate narrowly passed 50-47 yesterday in a rare bipartisan rebuke. The Senate vote turned on Louisiana's Bill Cassidy, who [crossed party lines](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOpiAURp9GOwxcEbSg2MZutt3SXOH6D1kEw8Ux8_abfx9hui_5kpOT8-dj-8CYYn79xpNcbccWSthC9ni3cvE3nTvWiswn5Ua8gQQj5CRAbTltqg8u-IDK9-SUtYuW8yJl_-nksgNqY-d5mcyCkz-s35U1YHEeNUAf3RslJwAplZ7scMwzjAZGfUxh2ZXptMREtQ2VrntP0WNuyH-PUj0Nvpx9cp-tXdyNvzpYO1if5xny7jM9_P47WK-SYoueO1h9ya9K_J5MGRsJDF-YPbGoxCXdLZYsKAcRK2bxYBWt3ucl9piS8Mgcw7eoPuOojZSqry5cT0wpsrGdlq8TY_qv1X5Q8cvBvwAAAP__32uDRw) to deliver the winning margin. Politico called potential House passage a "stunning embarrassment" for the president and his first major congressional defeat. Republican leaders are working to sink the resolution on the floor. Even if it passes, Trump is all but certain to veto -- but a successful [House floor vote](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2u3SAQRldjd1gw_i8o0rh7aVNaGIZrFAyIGV8nu49ulvDq79PR0fn1tX-ZEEN6_TQX6sp-d9ntLllzcy70F6_D1GqILkyMtIOESchRgNpT3FXrtLPOKNuiVvO8DnJZpWxP7eb-AL8cyix-lYOdnYfDK-XlogYFsg36g5IjgJRqGOfOLwv0E_SDH916qKkZpIlYuatY7iMGaxIb-u1ztdjZfLVRn8yFmv5HA1sD2_M8XTmoy_XVwJbwoTPftYGt5Bg4WPp8DNtTxPBGceabUOCfgpbRCc7inRlFToIwGUZRkXK8OeT0GWO4Aguu91VIPKaKkh-s1FbtyhNiDDTNzSBflwnxvx5_o-Zbw78AAAD__09piFg) would signal that congressional patience with the Iran campaign is wearing thin. ★★★
DNC Releases 2024 Autopsy

DNC Chair Ken Martin on Thursday [released the autopsy](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1urDAQhZ_GdKDxYDAULm5Dt7dNiWY9w64V8yPbG5K3j4jyBOmOdKTv6Hxvt_lGIYbt8Z9WcaksM-888-bpVfYjf8l6p5Qo51W2InlGwL6GrkY9b3HWFTv2TNpX4rS1o4FhBKiejnAUL2wIFu-tF27HQayhlqld7EBVcBcKOkQAbTrbLMOAbY-tWToe77pXBihKKk2S43WPwdNWKL8ve_LS-H2tonuWcmTV_lM4KZzO82zoM-z5ahVOF1_hBN2VtcKJZd19opJrBDT178M6SRTKwlVyfJwhxpB7qww8VgrxZ6n8QcyHw-8AAAD__y7dcak) of the party's 2024 losses -- months after first suppressing it -- complete with a disclaimer on every page stating the findings don't represent the DNC's official views. The disclaimer backfired. Martin himself called it "stupid" and apologized publicly, but [the admission triggered](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuO5CAURL8GMlpwjV8BwSbOetMNrWu4bqPlJaCnNX8_6tF8wcRVqtI5_-77HX3w6fEXI5naz91lt7tk8dlzaZ8UD6wVW4uUOrUdJExCjgLUnsKuuDPOOlSWk1HzvGq5rFLyyyg9zqtyB1i0atTT4PBcFB2OBgWogHvznpIjgJTv8u1cFhgmGPQ5uvVQE9MSA9V-q1SeR_AWU8f2_8zV0s3myIO5ei-NDX8YbAy2ftHlQ3hnDLYrR0r0agw2i7GgfyQG27gsqwIpXLICJGhRKjXvKHWPQVAg231O4gdeVCq5dlEpEDZisPFqXHn5EHybZqblI6L_fuT9F_I-DHwFAAD___Hffws) a full-blown leadership crisis. Axios reported the bungled rollout has produced "a crisis of confidence" in his chairmanship among party insiders. The report itself catalogs structural failures from the 2024 cycle -- messaging breakdowns, a last-minute candidate swap, and a fracturing coalition. [The autopsy documents](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O3SAUhJ_G7rjChz-7oEhzu02b0jocjnfRAraAzVXePnKUJ9hyNJrRzPfrbX_DlFN9_4mFfRvHHs-4x0r4Nc6r_-ESsDXsvXAd3HeQYIU0Apa95n2Zo48UcaGZ_eLcpuW6STl_eLWSM0oGWh05GzDSxhiDUceyKWXCnPxdJQ2AlIs27nGsKygLSh8mbmGxk5aYuY1H4-sr5ERYB_bP42zEDzrLnP3HGFef1I8JnhM88ar86rd1izYSZZ7gGbmc1HAkEhVHOitmQWcpaQxm8f-mAAlafHIV5U5WgfqwDowNmowNKJ1FJgZFAA5WjHPz8XqlnFO3btLyvWDK_2aNb1D87eFvAAAA___RCIFt) problems the party has yet to solve. The chaos around its release may ultimately overshadow whatever lessons it contains. ★★★
DOJ Indicts Raul Castro

The Justice Department indicted former Cuban President Raul Castro on [murder charges](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLtutDAUhJ_GdEbHB5tL4eJv6PZvU6KDL7tODEa2CcrbR-wjpJtiNPPp-3gsDwox7M__tDmdq19ssovdDZ01HeXHbSvlTKVsbq-uLAjYc1AcxbLHRTRWW2NJmMZpMQyThHECaF6aBoGdQ78CjgMo27lRSt8rKaVdjRFN0PcUKEQAIdXQ-nHErsdOemWnVfRMAkWXa5vdca4xGNorlS-fsnGtSVsT9avWo7DuH8OZ4XxdV3ukGGow6S4wnHd3FYbz_cRwBvXODGebPrk5V-KZzsgNlZoTNy_KT1e4jykHSxxgwkmqscnaHleIMZR-YBKeG4X4Jqh_EPat8TcAAP__tJp4AQ) for ordering the 1996 shootdown of two civilian aircraft flown by the exile group Brothers to the Rescue, killing four Americans. Castro is 94, brother of the late Fidel, and served as Cuba's leader for over a decade after his brother stepped down. [The federal indictment](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D2u3SAUBODV4A4Ljv9wQZHG3Uub0jpw8L3cYECAY2X3kbOEV480-mZ-fe1f6IOPr594Ol3asVOinaLFq6Vc_7rTYClY6-lic3UHATMXEwe5x7DLjjRZQmk7p-WyrKNQqxDdW5tBTgRuNcooRQQKUOGhSK4jyGkWnddPlZgAhJDjtPSHUjDMMIzHRKuRMxsFBldaX1y-TPAWY8P6-0jFut6mswv63VqubPjBYGOw3ffdR2Oju-uTM9hyCr55Wxlsn6s2bx0nl7G0ZwyDreAVuMXaSuI-krfNEW_lOjOn9OE5YHS8vlNqPr4qt5fByPF05cFUXmzEYZwWsXRFU759CL7OCxvF60Qf_iPbNz79o-FfAAAA__8oaYlg) marks an extraordinary moment: a former head of state named as a criminal defendant in a U.S. court. The move is the latest escalation in Trump's pressure campaign against Havana. Extradition is effectively impossible, but [the charges carry](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOtCAURp8GOw1cEbSg-Bu7-dstzQUuM2QRDeCaffvN7CNs9yVfck5yPh7bA2OK-fkfdzKlhc0ffvPZ4dWOs37TbrEUrHWn3KhuwEH1fOpBbDltovPGO4_CdWSE1ovk88J59zKoPWnOVZAKHOkgQ1jUOEsruLXTRF00bxSfADgXctJDmGcYFYwyTH6xQjHJMVFpQ6Hzsik6zA3rZziKo8Ede5fMq7WzsvEfg5XBet_34GzNdNf3z2B9TwZrwSv1DmsrRx-zj66R76_au8sig7Urxp93TClWpZnkzx1j-jW0PwT5MvATAAD___uucGo) enormous symbolic weight for Florida's Cuban-American community and signal the administration has no intention of softening its posture toward the island.
Trump's Purge Comes at Cost

Trump cleared the field -- Massie out, Georgia primaries locked -- but the purge may have created more House free agents and deepened the Senate Republican anger he's now counting on to suppress heading into 2026's [critical stretch](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1uwyAUxfGnsTesCwZ_DAxdsqVrR-sCFwcFYwtwrL59lS7dux_9jvT_ui93DDGk9RM30rn6xe1uccniWfejfNNmMGcsZaNUqSwCxMBAMcGXFBfeOu2sQ25b0nwcZwnTDNA-NPcgLXhUyLEflBlnUl4amoyk0Uhsg35ToIQA4FKNnZ8m0Q-il1652fChkYCRcu0yHaeJwWKqWJ5-z5Y6u29t1I9aj9L0H424NeJ2XVeX6CoX0fM9aMSt5nM72B9QWKbXHiuze1ozlcL8mVxIK3OhHGclxvk8AXDeZu2OK8QYyjA2EtYNQ_y9rf-o9NLiJwAA__9MFXjY).

★★★
Colorado Dems Censure Polis

Colorado Democrats formally censured Gov. Jared Polis after he pardoned Tina Peters, the convicted election equipment tamperer. The rebuke from his own party threatens to define his 2028 presidential ambitions before they [ever launch](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD1uxCAQhU-DO1swBv8UFGncbdqU1uww3iXBYAEbK7ePnCOkez_Sp6f3cVtv6IOPj3fc2ea6rS651UXCV01H-eH9jjljKTvHymUFCUMrTQtqjWFVjbOOHCpq2KpxnLWcZimbpyUNjKQk60npSWoyvVaSUCs2s9mmxtsLJQ2AlEqbsdumCfoBer0ZN9_VILTEwLl2mY_XPXjCWLF8bSkTd5T2JthnrUcR_ZuARcBynmdHMV6dgOWiC1ikubQSsBwp-OqpCFg-MbNrr6C0xLG8LksppIwutY73RBlraauP2B5cOZcmW3ecPgRfhlFo-djRh78Z9R-vfVv4DQAA__9873uy).

★★★
GOP Revolts Over DOJ Fund

AG Todd Blanche briefed Senate Republicans on Trump's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization" fund -- and the reception was icy. Sen. Thom Tillis called it "stupid," and Republicans who signed off now fear voters will see it as a [political slush fund](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D2OpTAQBODTmAxkN-YvcLAJ2dt0Q9S4m4d3bINsM2huP2KOMFlJJX0l1b_X8kLnXXz_xcAmlW2hgxaKFq9ynPmLw4opYc6BY-G8gIS-ll0Naol-URUZsoTKVmzUMExajpOU1W7aUSq7ku5YEyAjkp5QsRxGSwMOfeXMQ8kOQEqlu6HZxhHaHlq9dTStqhdaoudUmsTntXpnMRbMH9uRLDf2CJU3eylnFu0fAbOA-b7vxsbVPqWA-eEFzLJ7shIwl3SFs6bjf-3x3jBxvV2RanvEd-Kc69VjtDs3ewm-SobO23nvcj8ILd8Bnf9ZLb846dPAdwAAAP__QGN2Cg).

* * *
House Passes Bipartisan Housing Bill

The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act passed 396-13, with all 13 votes against coming from Republicans. The bill bans corporate investors from buying homes to rent and incentivizes new construction. It now [returns to the Senate](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDFuxCAURE8DnVefjw2moEjjbtOmtLD5XqMAtoDNKreP1kdIM5rRSK94X_f57kIM-fHpEtnSttkffvZ5dc92nPWX0uJKcbUmyo3qjICqg6FDMec4C-6tX70TKycrtDY9jAaA71aAVKC1UWYBJzdPoxTeSO9B46Bh4cG-UTAgAoh-0LdtHFEqlP02eLMIxXpwkUq7FTqfSwyry83V7-0oK93WI_Fo99bOyuQHw4nh1HbaQ4zvj-G0H4kyvepVn5UYTsM4aqlMd-0rQ350S4ixq5RdI16sP18hxlCVZj08kgsXj7d_qPmx-BcAAP__Uipyiw), where passage is uncertain.

★★★
GOP Advances Interior Funding Bill

House Appropriations Republicans advanced the FY2027 Interior, Environment, and Related Agencies bill out of subcommittee. It cuts EPA and environmental programs -- part of Congress's appropriations sprint to avoid another shutdown standoff. Democrats warn it will [raise utility bills](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2O5CAQhJ_GzrBwD_4LCC5xNpdeaLWh8aDDgGhmRvP2K2-wD7Dpp1Kp6vt33-7og4_HXzxJl-o2m-xmo8FnTZk_dO5YCjKfFCvxBhJGIQcB_RbD1rdWW2OxNy3pfpoWJedFyvahiZDcCLRMVipyRoFZ3D47BbTM_T60Xl9VcgCQslfD1Ll5htsIN-UGu-z92CiJgUrtCuXnHrzBWJH_u1QMdSadbdCPWjM3tz8NrA2smHNJuXisPkXuHunJ1B3p1cAa6c0NrLkQsygUCJkuYNJ5-lqJfqBwH5iEj5WKT0VQfPmS4nVeYLRXDCtZgQdF44nbom1--xA8j1Oj5HGiD9_r6i9kvjR8BQAA___3e4jd).

★★★

Team, The GOP's top super PAC has pledged over $17 million to try to buy New Hampshire’s Senate seat and hold onto their grip on the majority or even expand it by flipping this seat. That’s the largest investment in New Hampshire in a decade, so let’s be clear about what that kind of money could buy: 🍁 $17 million could buy more than 739,452 bottles of New Hampshire maple syrup. ⚾ $17 million could get you roughly 1.4 million tickets to a New Hampshire Fisher Cats game. 🪧 $17 million could buy over 35,000 yard signs or 15 million bumper stickers. Instead national Republicans are planning to spend $17 million to flood the airwaves with attack ads right here in New Hampshire. The GOP knows this race could decide control of the Senate, so they’re investing in the Granite State early in this campaign – they’re betting they can drown out the people-powered grassroots campaign we’re building. I’m not taking anything for granted. And I won’t let the GOP and their outside groups buy this seat without a fight. We’re not waiting for a $17 million check; instead we’re counting on folks like you, chipping in when they can. If enough people chip in $20 at a time, we can build the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to fight back and win. Thank you, Chris Pappas New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

name: Sarah McBride
subject: We have to be clear eyed about the road ahead
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I posted this to social media recently, but it was important to me that you see it, too.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3300%2E21716%2EXjCZXZ)
Hi there,
**I wanted to share my thoughts on the ever-evolving landscape of voting rights and gerrymandering — both partisan and racial.** I posted this to social media recently, but it was important to me that you see it, too. I hope you’ll give it a read, because this issue is incredibly important to the future of our democracy.
* * *
Redistricting and its broader implications have undoubtedly defined this moment and shaped the political terrain heading into the midterms. Trump and his enablers in Congress and state legislatures across the country started this fight — and what we are seeing in real time is a coordinated and sustained campaign to shape political power before voters ever even reach a polling place, while undermining Black voters and voters of color.
**Bottom line: courts are overriding the will of voters and new barriers are being instituted to make voting harder.** The president and Congressional Republicans are committed to one goal: undermining your power to cast your fundamental right to vote and carving up communities to disenfranchise those who marched and bled for that right — all while continuing to cast doubt on the security of our elections.
That is the point. They want people to be scared to vote, and they are willing to use whatever levers they have at their disposal to undermine our democratic processes and overturn results they do not agree with.
As we head toward the midterms, we have to be clear eyed about the road ahead. Right now, we are seeing elected officials who cannot defend their record on costs, corruption, health care, civil rights, or the economy trying to insulate themselves from accountability by altering the rules of representation in the midst of an election.
That is the broader conversation we need to be having. Not just whether this map or that map is fair, or whether one ruling is right or wrong — but whether every community will have equal power to choose their representatives and determine their future.
**Every single voice matters. Every single vote counts. And every attempt to dilute, suppress, or discard that power must be named for what it is: disenfranchisement and utterly undemocratic.**
* * *
With Republicans seeking to suppress the vote and undermine the will of the people, we need to win this November by a margin that’s too big to contest. **If you want to help me win re-election and flip the House this November, can I count on you to[make a donation of $5 or any amount today to help us keep up the fight?](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260521-1.5uPrc2&refcode=em20260521-3300&amount=5&t=2&akid=3300%2E21716%2EXjCZXZ)**
---
Thank you,
Sarah McBride

Hard work and playing by the rules used to be enough. That was the deal. You show up, put in the hours, do everything right, and you build something stable. A home. A future. A life your kids can step into with confidence.
That deal is broken. And politicians like my opponent Scott DesJarlais helped break it.
While families across Tennessee's 4th District are working two jobs just to cover groceries, while parents lie awake wondering if their kids will ever be able to afford a home of their own, DesJarlais has spent 14 years in Washington protecting the donors and insiders who bankroll his career. **How do I know?**_**I 'm living it **_**with my boys:**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5abfed99-fce6-4beb-8bec-49f3d96f9c7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**I 'm running for Congress because I look at my boys and I refuse to accept that the America they inherit is one where effort doesn't matter anymore. [Will you stand with us?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/222390f2-eda2-4792-8bf8-9b5b0685690b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Chip in $25, Help us hit our goal!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/222390f2-eda2-4792-8bf8-9b5b0685690b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We aren't seeing representation anymore. Corporate and Foreign interests have infiltrated our government. The "American Dream" isn't their priority anymore because **corporate checks line their pockets.**
To Scott DesJarlais and every other bought-and-paid-for politician in Washington: consider this your notice. I got to this state with nothing to my name, and was able to build a family while pulling through the worst. My goal is to make sure **you** can do the same, and not have to break your back in the process.
The people of this district are done waiting, and we're coming. ☑️ _**[Chip in $20 today and let's finish this.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/222390f2-eda2-4792-8bf8-9b5b0685690b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)☑️**_

Republicans don’t want you to remember the war in Iraq, or the war in Afghanistan.
#
Peter, Republicans don’t want you to remember the war in Iraq, or the war in Afghanistan.
They want you to forget about it because they want to run everything back. That’s what Trump’s doing right now in Iran: A complete repeat of all of the mistakes Republicans made in the aftermath of 9/11. They don’t have any new ideas, they don’t have long-term plans, they have no vision for the future.
All they want to do is take us back, and their ability to do that depends on us forgetting how terrible a job they did before. But we will never forget being lied into wars we never should’ve had to fight, watching our friends get blown up and killed, or hearing from their wives and kids after they took their own lives when they came home.
We are the Veterans of Forever Wars. We remember. And we refuse to let them get away with this.

name: Rose Penelope Yee
subject: The People vs. Special Interests
body:
Thomas Massie lost because AIPAC and corporate PACs poured a record amount of money into Kentucky to defeat him. This distorts democracy.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/utw59s1kPbB?e=8c53948e4c&c2id=06d66eac9b545d55bb613c1fdc65532c)
| | | | | |
# Reject AIPAC and corporate PACs
---
| | Hello friends,
We just saw Thomas Massie lose his primary election after AIPAC and corporate PACs poured a record-breaking amount of money into his district.
**Although he is a Republican and we disagree on most issues, it is a fact that corporate control and outside interests distort our democracy. Buying influence and drowning out the voices of everyday people is wrong.**
But corporate money and foreign interests don’t always win. Chris Rabb, a DSA-backed Democrat faced those exact same obstacles, yet he overcame the onslaught to win. **That is the path we are taking.**
I am not backed by corporate PACs, AIPAC, or foreign interests. I answer only to you, the people of District 2. When we rise up and organize, we can defeat these powerful forces.
That’s why I am incredibly proud to announce that our movement is growing. We have officially been endorsed by the **Shasta County DSA**! This endorsement is a testament to the grassroots momentum we are building to reclaim our democracy from corporate control.
**I hope I can earn your vote in the Primary, and together, we can defeat corporate-backed establishment forces and take our movement for People, Peace, and Planet to Washington DC. Can you contribute a few dollars today to ensure we finish strong and move on to the General Election?**

name: Case Dixon
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Supporters and friends,

I want to share with you the press release that went out earlier today.

**PRESS RELEASE**

Case Dixon Officially Qualifies for August 11 Special Primary

Hueytown, AL — Republican congressional candidate Case Dixon released the following statement after officially qualifying for the August 11 special primary election in Alabama’s 6th Congressional District:

“When I started this campaign back in the spring of 2025, I knew without a doubt it would be an uphill battle. I’m a 26-year-old husband, father, and healthcare worker who doesn’t come from a politically connected family, challenging a 12-year incumbent. I’d never run for office before, but I believed in something greater than myself.

I believed in standing up for what’s right—for truth. I believed it was time to push back against the reign of career politicians. To truly fight for limited government, free markets, constitutional liberties, and individual responsibility. I believed it was time for young people to have a voice in our government again. But most importantly, I believed in unapologetically taking a stand for our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in this pivotal moment in history. We desperately need Him now more than ever.

I’ve learned so much from this experience and met so many incredible people along the way. It has genuinely given me hope for the future of this state and our nation.

Some may not realize this, but the results from my race this past Tuesday were not binding. Yes, I was on your ballot and votes were tallied, but your vote did not determine the Republican nominee for Alabama’s 6th Congressional District. Due to the redistricting process and changes to the congressional lines, the votes cast on May 19 will not be certified, and there will instead be a special primary election for this race on August 11.

After speaking with my wife, close friends, and spending time in prayer, I feel led to qualify for this special election and finish the race I started.

I believe that when you commit yourself to something bigger than yourself, and when others place their trust and support in you, you should see it through to the end. With the way this race was reset through redistricting, I do not feel I have done that.

I understand the uphill nature of this race, but I also believe this special election and the next three months provide voters with a unique opportunity to truly evaluate both candidates, hear directly about our vision for the future, and make a decision based on principles, policies, and the direction they want for our district and country.

I feel I owe it to my family after countless nights away from home, days without seeing my children, and the sacrifices my wife has made carrying so much of the burden while I’ve been on the campaign trail.

I feel I owe it to every person who donated financially to this campaign. When someone donates, they are giving more than money, they are giving their time and labor, which is one of the most valuable things a person has. I owe it to every volunteer who gave their time, energy, and effort because they also believed in something greater than themselves.

And I feel I owe it to the people of District 6 to continue giving voters a choice in this election and to continue earning the trust and support of this district over the next three months.

I do not make this decision lightly. I genuinely believe this is what I am being called to do. I humbly ask that you continue to keep me and my family in your thoughts and prayers, and that you continue helping us spread our message to friends, family, and voters across AL-6.

Thank you all again for the support, encouragement, prayers, and kindness you’ve shown my family and me throughout this journey. No matter what happens, I can promise you this: I will never stop fighting for the future of our children, our freedoms, and the values that make this country worth preserving.”

###

I am thankful for each and every one of you. I cannot do it without you.

In Liberty,
Case Dixon
[signatureImage]
Dixon for Congress
(205) 282-9103
615 Brooklane Dr. #3218
Hueytown, AL 35023-2508
DIXONFORUSCONGRESS.COM

# [This Democratic Nominee for Congress Invites You to a FUNdraiser in Gettysburg!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/05/21/this-democratic-nominee-for-congress-invites-you-to-a-fundraiser-in-gettysburg/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on May 21, 2026
---
| Thank you, Voters and Volunteers, from the bottom of my heart.
---
Not only did you make me the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, you showed your heart for Democracy especially in this critical election year.
---
Based on the unofficial results so far for yesterday’s primary election, Democratic turnout for PA-13 averaged about 27%, while Republican turnout averaged about 19%.
---
Moreover, there is less heart for Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, to lead this district. While I basically held my ground from the 2024 presidential primary election, losing only 900 votes, he lost over 24,351 votes between the two primaries.
---
To help me reach more voters and clinch this win, I ask that you please donate to my campaign at: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=0de32597ac03267af9a29a658a024f3235ac185317d400b95e081e88e6ca6bb2&blog_id=213069660&post_id=7554&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=ff0bfd56055a8f438a8cbeda3785bbc4&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=81afc68956900fab24dffd8ec66691e6) or come to the fundraiser above and donate there! You can also mail a check, made out to Beth Farnham for Congress, to:
---
Beth Farnham for Congress
---
P.O. Box 72
---
McSherrystown, PA 17344
---
I will keep showing up for you because I believe in US. Please look for my tent at local fairs and festivals, my in-person Town Halls, my literature, and phone calls throughout the election season, then please vote for me on November 3rd!
---
And please vote for the following Democratic candidates who also won their nominations around PA-13 –

Sean Steeg for the 30th State Senate,
---

name: Newt Gingrich
subject: I’ve spent 40 years fighting for conservative values in this country. Here’s what I’ve learned.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alme for Senate
body:
Read this critical intel about the upcoming Montana election. |
---
Fellow Patriot,

I've spent decades fighting for conservative values.

I've known a lot of candidates. Very few actually deliver results.

Kurt Alme does.

Born and raised in Montana, Kurt loves this state. As U.S. Attorney, appointed by President Trump and confirmed twice by the Senate, he took on violent criminals, drug traffickers, and cartel networks threatening Montana families.

Under his leadership, criminal prosecutions hit a 20-year high to make communities safer.

That's not talk. That's action.

Now Kurt is running for the United States Senate, and I am proud to stand behind him.

**Kurt is in the homestretch before the 6/2 election and every dollar counts. We still need 300 grassroots conservatives to step up asap.[Can Kurt and I count on you for $6?](http://links.kurtalme.com/u/click?_t=13f02befef694c2ea0e5bfe0ba1ceb44&_m=8a29c392cdb74ab192ad6dbfcbf29bf7&_e=8s4qTZlGgvKUzZjgV__tNehkD0hkdsj7_wdJofO9mvvQfCBQlKkxzs6Cd8fQxJus6r6up589iX0_QSQQA5pVwj9Q0oIKVdnzY9Arll1ZKNvoo1A_TpzEN7pAAmBint1dOW_Ow1qe9wX6pUZFZJhcJ8iL9Pa07IIfcuGZZJF2iMf_CKb7kV0HmavvPXQXwx-7gAz5McyGgtuoMs7wE0Hn1wsEUf-9XaFj4byonA7QwBG-lZoHkJyhG17XF3IySd8FW9IMXMkubX3PfCwJ-2vlFHpX683jZUESfDiZR2X24Ma2Ir6Zq2QbDpr3OcjLAvEeiHf7N8TCrEsqefYfcWMg8K-P85MwogRS7YVDf7n8_3Wn8pmohBO6qkQVFgnI48ZtaQ77GLv7nVzpS1ekWB1cmSUR9oZOaRXXBMTLf8bGuk17Z2MF5tE2ow18t7LYUwYG0yil5xIe0fEU9ra9x9tOOcYWze-T1Y-jtvfpZluz0anhntXLifVe1X7tVF2X_msYHgQwFNJPYjh2v5DzsQ1LxphEKArzk27C22zT-9mqUes45nlk4KgLDANqiAt0cQgrAPP-r1zC98L7vVGa4yDAteKM5lofZNaQhdArJ7SUMdA777-A4FnNdnUyAxplmF2BHoznvfIiowM47nimTHgKlIydEYaldVlqMFaG2qwzDMui7XJZZSdsTZLOghHorOGdaf-sZB31ViKCvOQedNaWnFyRC4Jooe80ONCCLp5POIbC1w0v53KLOfDiIPMvlm_XzmWGyC24BkFKKlPBE1juSg%3D%3D)**

Montana is a battleground. Democrats know it. They are already pouring money into this race.

body:
This move strips nearly 2 million Tennesseans of the representation they deserve.
| Friend,

Last week, I received official notice from Tennessee House Speaker Cameron Sexton that I had been **removed from all of my state House committee assignments — _alongside every other_ Tennessee House Democrat.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109781?t=6&akid=24478%2E878179%2Euhjo0W) This is one of the **_most troubling abuses of power_** in our state’s history.

Friend, this kind of retaliation only works if we let them intimidate us into silence. I won’t let it, but I’ll need your help to keep fighting. [So if you’re able to, split $10 or more right now with our campaign and the Voter Protection Project to keep our grassroots Movement strong enough to defend ourselves and our communities from this authoritarian attack.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109781?t=7&akid=24478%2E878179%2Euhjo0W) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109781?t=8&akid=24478%2E878179%2Euhjo0W)
---
If this sounds familiar, it should. Because this is what TN House Republicans do when they don’t like what you have to say.

More than three years ago, they expelled me after I protested on the House floor against their inaction on gun violence. They thought they could make an example of me for refusing to be quiet while our communities were hurting.

Now, they’re doing it all over again.

In early May, they pushed through rigged, racist maps designed to eliminate TN-09’s identity as a majority-Black, Democratic district. TN House Democrats stood together and made it clear that we would not stand for this injustice.

So they retaliated.

Committee assignments aren’t ceremonial positions. They’re how state lawmakers do the day-to-day work of representing our communities — from hearing bills, shaping policy, and fighting for the needs of the People who sent us there.

But no matter what, they can’t strip away our voice, our courage, and our commitment to our People and neighborhoods. Civil rights icon and former Representative John Lewis taught us to make good trouble — necessary trouble.

With your support, we’ll keep doing just that.

[Please split $10 or more with our campaign and the Voter Protection Project in the next 30 minutes so we have the resources to fight back against this latest abuse of power.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109781?t=9&akid=24478%2E878179%2Euhjo0W)

## Senate GOP Refuses to Vote on Trump's Bill
Senate Republicans on Thursday [delayed voting on a $72 billion immigration](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAUhJ_GdCBzMDgULm5Dl9tuiQw-hrPxD7KdsHn7VbLSvsC2o5nRzPdxna-aHIXtv_aoio1zwDM7LAXTvMXjuOd90est6LzqlG9Ph8s9z8BhqHlfA8xGk3vOojLKIgJ2FapWylEIIQaodgXWmlHqxXadbVvZ92a5rK2UPSyGm7arSL3aeA_Qci67sRmWzvIFzTrKXqwwMsHRUImp-YwUyo7WPeMDU7NGXzm1l3Jk1v1jMDGYzvNsTp13CluJAb-0p_BjZTC9vjGYMgZdkMEkenkRcPmV6uMeSq7Je9qSLhRDjcHGtKLHUOpHfKeqpMxxknOUB8kE37wm9x5T_kTwoeA7AAD__zsBhz4) enforcement bill, leaving for the Memorial Day recess and missing President Trump's June 1 deadline. The bill stalled over the Trump administration's [$1.8 billion fund](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFuhCAURb8GdxgERmXBoknjbpruujQIT30dBAM4E_v1jf2Frk9yc8_5uo93gx7D8mE20GWOY4BX9lAKpHGJ-37kdTL2EUy2JuXH6WE68sgZbym7Uc5HZ9Cfo6ycngE4iAp003VKSilbXq1aQdM1ginnbA99pxyzjIFoTDur3jJWob7W2I3zhrFOqLqdxMwmcFZ1N2m5IpKBwxJT_R0xlBVmf8YnpNrGrfJ6LWXPRLwRPhA-mMleBvUSL0z48Bk9FrSZ8CHBfkwerQmZwgkYFpogl4S2YAyZlnRse6YmFKQvMHsM-GMuROcjOFpizhgWwodcYjqJGNAR8d4I0fSXcpW021_oPea2I5Itm0H_d7L8q-xT898AAAD__2QMj8Q) for allies who say they were politically persecuted, with Republicans worried about how the money would be allocated. The money was part of Trump's settlement with the IRS. Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-La., who lost his primary after Trump endorsed his opponent, criticized the fund, saying voters care more about groceries and gas prices. GOP lawmakers are also divided over whether [to include a $1 billion request](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAUhJ_GdETOwRgoXGxDl223RP45hrMxNrJNouzTr7j3EW47I32j-f48loemQHH9rXdU1acl4rsErBXzsqbjOMtmtH1GXazO5fkJaM6yAAfZ8r4FWJym8FlE45RHBOwaVPdhmIQQQkKzKT5C5_ykuR2sN6KDTjrXc9EPBqWbfEPqovEe4M750E03aTrPDTo7Db2wMDHB0VFN-fY3Uawb-vBJL8w3m_YmqK3Wo7DuF4OZwVw33CiEq2Mwb2nH6xCDuWDUFRnM_ThOUo6tOd2Ktc1oU7QUSFdKsdWxUvtGfaRI_74jf0bXZjxOE8jqeMGarNzxphCoyIEJvu6avjab-iOJLwX_AwAA__-7fYiL) for the Secret Service over the prospect that the money could be used to construct Trump's new 90,000-square-foot White House ballroom.

## NASCAR Star Kyle Busch Dies at 41
NASCAR superstar Kyle Busch [died Thursday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u7CAUhJ8Gd1hwfPxXUNyGbm-b0sJwbJNljQXsWn77aBMpL5B6RqP5vo_bdDM--H39bx6kyhKnnc4cqBRK0xqP45m32dj7brI1Kd-vQPMzTyCg46LlAJMzPlwTVk4tREBNRUr2_YiI2EG1qVmadkBshOyksUaKHoWVcsEeBIjWVV6910QLIIXom7Hu5mYRMzk79i1aGBkKcr7EVH9Gv5eNlnDFF6XaxkcV1FbKkVnzj4FmoM_zrCkf-ztkoJOxfl8Z6B8ABjqXmC4GemKgvWOgcRiaoZP4W-Lexp2_Ufn8zHbjzlPmZiWOskrKHacPweeuZyjWh_Hh-0j5k72Xgq8AAAD__z8VgZo) at age 41, hours after his family announced he was hospitalized with a severe illness. The cause has not been disclosed. Busch was in his 22nd full-time Cup Series season, having [won championships](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHypCAMh58GOxyMIEtBcY3dXnulgxCUWxRHcJ19-xtuH-HfJZP5Jd-XP8_paUIM-_LbbKiLT9OOd45YCp7Tko7jyuts7Gs32Zozvz4R5ytPwGCgTFCAyZkQPxNvnPaIgH2DupNScc75AM2qreiUMuLBBnRe9lzhQ3jhjRxm6yU8mqDrNiYAOsZkr9ph7j2b0VklBbegCGfoQkln-zeFvazo4ye98Wxt2pqo11KOTPpfBEYC433f7Re2jgmM1Ydu6IIhMNZLBEYmat0RGKsQna9sV1ruREvYkH7j1F4HzXgGzNSuZjtC2qmrnSnULEh5zTendscdYgx5kISzZTMh_gcrP_rmW8O_AAAA___AiIh6) in 2015 and 2019. His 63 Cup wins rank ninth all-time. Across NASCAR's three national divisions, his [234 combined wins](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3ynSAQBfCn0Q4HV65eCoo0dv-0KR0-Vt2IwgBeY54-Y_IIqXfnzPmdH1_TlyZPx_Jd76jKHKYDr-yxFEzTEmI882q03Q6drU55uz2aM0_AoWf8xQAmp8nfk6idmhEBuxpVOwxSCCF6qFdlBJczoIPhbbSTBm3vzFu8ubSS99jWpJ40_gJoOR862fSmm7lBZ-XwEhZkJTg6KiE1PwMdZcXZ3-GDqbFhr71aS4m56r5VMFYwXtfVzOHXo3juFYzhLBvZjeUYUskVjOUKrNCO7B-K2TOyjIkwM7vqPVI42ANl5sx2ZSXphaz2_mbu-REtW0OOVLSn37pQOOqkXLzIe8r9UAm-7Jr833blvyb9KPgTAAD__99Gj8Q) are the most in the sport's history. He drove the No. 8 Chevrolet for Richard Childress Racing. Sunday's Coca-Cola 600 at Charlotte will go on as planned, with [Austin Hill stepping in](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGP3CAUhH8N7t4KP2P7KCjSuLu0Ka0HPGyyrLGA3ZP_fbQXKX8g3UijGX0zvz7XT4opHttPerBpIa8Hf9XErXFZt3yez7pbcveDqqNS71di-6wrSpxAjoC4eorpWlXnTWBGHjo2_TxrpZSasNuNn5k--qBkH1gN3k22x9E51h9WT0HrLpp3mxwReynnQd8mOwRp2Ts9j8qhFkqyjy2X2-8cj7ZzSFd-cbm5_OiS2Vs7qxh-CFwELjvT63o7Apd65tKqwOUv_T8BiTc-PLzXgH1Wt4OPXIEaqB6owncQAjmusDOVZgvTPR4bpFwrWA65MLjsCFxOBJOUApeuGH9-xZRinWah5PagmL4h2389-zL4JwAA__9ZP495) for Busch in the No. 8. body:
We can’t take our foot off the gas.

---

---
| | | | | From Trump:** "I know him, he's a FIGHTER".**

It's President Trump's right-hand man in Florida, Byron Donalds. I'm honored by President Trump's trust and support.

And he just came down to Florida, and we delivered a HISTORIC address.

Things are heating up, and my primary is ALMOST here. Now's not the time to sit back on the sidelines

I can't thank President Trump enough for coming down and for the kind words that he gave me. But make no mistake, the message is clear:

**We cannot take our foot off the gas.**

If we slow down for even a moment, Democrats will capitalize on it.

When they smell weakness, they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

And if we let them seize Florida, our whole country will be next.

**Since the day I announced my candidacy for Governor, the floodgates were opened.**

There's nothing that angers Democrats more than a man like me REFUSING to sit down, shut up, and follow their so far-left agenda.

I'm MAGA to the bone, and President Trump knows that.

That's why he is DOUBLING DOWN on helping me become Florida's next Governor, and I need all of MAGA to do the same.

And I'm humbly asking YOU to help me kickstart the momentum.

Will you join President Trump and me?
---

It's the future of the MAGA Movement as we know it.

But I won't back down, not with President Trump's endorsement and not with MAGA patriots like you standing beside me.

**I 'm not one to give in to attacks, and I'm hoping you won't back down either.**

President Trump knows I'm the man to get this done, and now I'm humbly asking you to join him in placing your trust in me.

Can I count on you?
